outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomic cluster map overlaid on tissue image showing categorical cluster assignments per spot; this is a spatial visualization, not a bar/box/violin chart of averaged data, so individual data point overlay is not applicable.
H&E photographs with manual region annotations (schematic overlay); no averaged quantitative data is plotted here.

H&E photograph plus spatial expression heatmap-style overlays (continuous color scale per spot for Tmprss11b, Trp63, Hnf4a); heatmap-type spatial visualizations are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Bar chart shows log2 fold-change values, a single derived statistic per gene from differential expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers/Wilcoxon test) comparing pooled spatial spot populations, not a mean of discrete biological replicates with hidden variability, so individual data points are not applicable in the same sense as replicate-based bar charts.
